# Context Cloud

> Context Cloud is an MCP memory server with shared team workspaces, typed knowledge chunks (decision, finding, convention, state, question, reference), role-based access control, and cross-tool support for Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf. It is the only MCP memory server built for engineering teams. Free tier available.

Context Cloud gives AI coding sessions persistent, structured memory that works across tools and teammates. When one engineer's AI session commits knowledge — architecture decisions, conventions, findings, project state — any teammate's AI session can recall it instantly with full attribution. The system uses two-layer retrieval: LLM-based knowledge base selection followed by hybrid vector/BM25/RRF fusion search. Knowledge is automatically deduplicated and superseded when facts evolve. Zero server-side LLM costs — extraction happens on the client AI tool.

Connect via MCP endpoint: https://api.contextcloud.pro/mcp/protocol
Connect via npm: npx @contextcloud/mcp-client
MCP Registry: io.github.abhinavala/context-cloud

## MCP Tools

Context Cloud exposes 5 MCP tools:
- check_memory: Returns table of contents for the user's persistent memory — workspaces, knowledge bases, session summaries, and the most recently active knowledge base. Call at session start or when the user references past work.
- search_memory: Hybrid vector + BM25 semantic search across shared team knowledge bases. Returns typed chunks (decisions, findings, conventions, state) with author attribution and timestamps. Supports filtering by knowledge base, chunk type, and workspace.
- save_memory: Commits structured knowledge from the current session to a shared team knowledge base. The AI tool extracts typed chunks (decision, finding, convention, state, question, reference) with rationale and context. Automatic deduplication and supersession of stale facts.
- check_updates: Returns changes to knowledge bases since the last session or a specified date. Shows new chunks committed by teammates, superseded facts, and knowledge base activity.
- manage_knowledge_bases: List, create, rename, or archive knowledge bases within a workspace.
